name: Villangómez (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally yellow over red with five green triangular gyrons at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villangómez (a saltire, a sword and a tree on red and yellow).
history: The flag of Villangómez is square and tricolour, green, yellow and red (or and gules); on the hoist edge there are five green triangular gyrons of equal base and height which meet the yellow in the upper half and the red in the lower half, with the arms of the town at the heart of the flag.

features.role: five triangular gyrons of equal base and height at the hoist
